_note: Exchange trading holidays (full-day closes). Used to shift rollover dates onto the previous trading day and to treat the market as closed. 'common' applies to every exchange; add exchange-specific extras under 'NFO' / 'MCX' (e.g. days MCX trades only the evening session can be REMOVED from MCX by listing them only under NFO). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Verify each year against the NSE/MCX holiday circulars — this seed list covers 2025-2026 as best known.
